//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the label component. NEUTRAL scenarios (framework-agnostic prop bags) + the GOLDEN markup core blesses for each. Scoped to the single `label` component (pa-label) that keen `label/1` and svelte `Label.svelte` render — the lighter tag-style sibling of pa-badge in badges.html. pa-label is a flat, self-contained <span>: a tinted-bg + coloured-border indicator with colour variants, a size scale, and a single --outline modifier. It owns NO __element classes (no icon/remove slot). Wrapper dumpers map `props` to their own API, render, and the core comparator diffs their output against `golden` after normalization. See ../README.md and badge.json for the model.

propsVocabulary.variant: colour variant (primary|secondary|success|warning|danger|info) — NOTE: label has NO light/dark, unlike badge
propsVocabulary.outline: boolean — transparent background + coloured border/text (pa-label--outline); composes with a colour variant
propsVocabulary.label: inner text content

goldenConventions: Structural only — labels add no attribute conventions. The label is a plain <span>; a variant modifier is present when a variant is set, a size modifier when a size is set, and pa-label--outline when outline is true. Slot content is a plain text token so the diff checks the wrapper's structural nesting, not rich content. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away by the comparator, so goldens are written for readability. Unlike badge there is NO theme-color, icon, or pill — pa-label is flat with no element-level classes.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (NOT components.json — its static extraction misses SCSS variants). `produces` is a class template with {value} placeholders; capability.mjs expands it and cross-checks against main.css AND each wrapper's map + the scenario set. `produces: null` = structural/native (no pa-label modifier). The full .pa-label--* set in main.css is exactly: primary, secondary, success, warning, danger, info (6 colours), xs, sm, lg, xl (4 sizes), outline — all claimed below.

cssStateClasses.//: pa-label--* classes in main.css that are NOT feature-driven props in this slice, so the axis-1 reverse check doesn't read them as an unmapped feature. (None — all 11 modifiers are feature-driven.)

deferred.//: pa-label__* element classes in main.css that this component does not own. pa-label is flat and emits no __element classes, so there is nothing to defer.

scenarios.name: size-default
scenarios.note: The unmodified size — no pa-label--{size} class is emitted.

scenarios.name: combined
scenarios.note: Stacks variant + size + outline to exercise the full class ordering together.
